taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-02 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 364.5 | 0.81 | 0.81
2 | 257.8 | 2.53 | 3.34
3 | 745.5 | 12.65 | 15.99
4 | 1146.1 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-02
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 3.34 m – 15.99 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive saturated layer between approximately 3.3 m and 16 m depth for screen placement; terminate drilling once the high-resistivity basement (>1100 ohm-m) is encountered below ~16 m, as it indicates unweathered bedrock with limited water-bearing potential.
